info.title: HitPay APIs
info.description:
Merchant API for OAuth apps (App Studio, third-party clients).

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` only. The token selects the
business — there is **no** `{business_id}` in the path. Do not send an API key
header.

**Scopes:** use the parent only — `payments`, `commerce`, `customer`.
A parent covers every child (`payments` includes read/create/cancel/refund,
`commerce` includes read/create/update/delete, same for `customer`).
Do not request `payments:read` and similar child scopes.

Response bodies reuse the dashboard docs schemas. Request shapes that differ
only by auth (no BusinessId header/path) are defined here.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description:
Optional ISO 4217 currency code (three letters). Values are normalized to lowercase.

When set to a currency other than the business primary currency, product and variation
response fields `currency`, `price`, `price_display`, and `price_stored` reflect
checkout-currency amounts. The companion field `business_currency_price` always
returns the amount in the business primary currency.

**`supported_currency_prices`** on the response contains **only manually stored** prices
from the database — never computed conversion rows.

**Price resolution order** (per variation; sets `price_source` when resolved):

1. Manual price in `supported_currency_prices` for the checkout currency → `price_source: manual`
2. Store manual exchange rate (`supported-currencies`, `use_live_exchange_rate: false`) → `price_source: store_exchange_rate`
3. Live exchange rate (store live config or market rate) → `price_source: live_exchange_rate`

If no price can be resolved, `is_unavailable_for_selected_currency` is `true` and
`price`, `price_stored`, and `price_display` are `null` (no fallback to business currency).

**POS hide filter:** When the business setting `pos_hide_without_checkout_currency_price`
is enabled (`1`) and this parameter is set, product list, search, and show endpoints
exclude products that have no manual checkout-currency price (or `open_amount`).
Search uses the database repository instead of Meilisearch while this filter is active.

currency.description:
3-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the displayed `price` fields. When
`checkout_currency` is omitted or matches the business primary currency, this
is the business currency. Otherwise it is the requested checkout currency.

price.description:

price_display.description:

price_stored.description:
Display price in minor units for `currency`. `null` when the product is unavailable
for the selected checkout currency.

price_source.description:
How the resolved display or line-item price was determined when checkout currency
differs from the business primary currency.

- **`manual`** — explicit row in `supported_currency_prices` for the checkout currency
- **`store_exchange_rate`** — converted from the business-currency catalog price using the
  store's **manual** exchange rate (with `exchange_rate_adjustment` when configured)
- **`live_exchange_rate`** — converted using a live market rate (with store
  `exchange_rate_adjustment` when the checkout currency is configured in store settings)

Omitted when checkout currency equals the business primary currency (native catalog price).

parameters.description:
Optional ISO 4217 currency code (three letters). Values are normalized to lowercase.

When set to a currency other than the business primary currency, product and variation
response fields `currency`, `price`, `price_display`, and `price_stored` reflect
checkout-currency amounts. The companion field `business_currency_price` always
returns the amount in the business primary currency.

**`supported_currency_prices`** on the response contains **only manually stored** prices
from the database — never computed conversion rows.

**Price resolution order** (per variation; sets `price_source` when resolved):

1. Manual price in `supported_currency_prices` for the checkout currency → `price_source: manual`
2. Store manual exchange rate (`supported-currencies`, `use_live_exchange_rate: false`) → `price_source: store_exchange_rate`
3. Live exchange rate (store live config or market rate) → `price_source: live_exchange_rate`

If no price can be resolved, `is_unavailable_for_selected_currency` is `true` and
`price`, `price_stored`, and `price_display` are `null` (no fallback to business currency).

**POS hide filter:** When the business setting `pos_hide_without_checkout_currency_price`
is enabled (`1`) and this parameter is set, product list, search, and show endpoints
exclude products that have no manual checkout-currency price (or `open_amount`).
Search uses the database repository instead of Meilisearch while this filter is active.

stock_keeping_unit.description: Stock keeping unit of the product

currency.description:
3-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the displayed `price` fields. When
`checkout_currency` is omitted or matches the business primary currency, this
is the business currency. Otherwise it is the requested checkout currency.

price.description:
Display price in major units for `currency`. With checkout `currency`, reflects the
resolved checkout-currency amount when available; `null` when
`is_unavailable_for_selected_currency` is `true`.

price_display.description:
Formatted display price for `currency`. `null` when the product is unavailable for
the selected checkout currency.

price_stored.description:
Display price in minor units for `currency`. `null` when the product is unavailable
for the selected checkout currency.

price_source.description:
How the resolved display or line-item price was determined when checkout currency
differs from the business primary currency.

- **`manual`** — explicit row in `supported_currency_prices` for the checkout currency
- **`store_exchange_rate`** — converted from the business-currency catalog price using the
  store's **manual** exchange rate (with `exchange_rate_adjustment` when configured)
- **`live_exchange_rate`** — converted using a live market rate (with store
  `exchange_rate_adjustment` when the checkout currency is configured in store settings)

Omitted when checkout currency equals the business primary currency (native catalog price).

is_unavailable_for_selected_currency.description:
When checkout `currency` is requested, indicates whether a display price could not be
resolved for that currency. When `true`, `price`, `price_stored`, and `price_display`
are `null`.

business_currency_price.description:
Price in the business primary currency. Always returned on product and variation
responses that include display price fields, regardless of whether `currency`
is requested.

CheckoutCurrency.description:
Optional ISO 4217 currency code (three letters). Values are normalized to lowercase.

When set to a currency other than the business primary currency, product and variation
response fields `currency`, `price`, `price_display`, and `price_stored` reflect
checkout-currency amounts. The companion field `business_currency_price` always
returns the amount in the business primary currency.

**`supported_currency_prices`** on the response contains **only manually stored** prices
from the database — never computed conversion rows.

**Price resolution order** (per variation; sets `price_source` when resolved):

1. Manual price in `supported_currency_prices` for the checkout currency → `price_source: manual`
2. Store manual exchange rate (`supported-currencies`, `use_live_exchange_rate: false`) → `price_source: store_exchange_rate`
3. Live exchange rate (store live config or market rate) → `price_source: live_exchange_rate`

If no price can be resolved, `is_unavailable_for_selected_currency` is `true` and
`price`, `price_stored`, and `price_display` are `null` (no fallback to business currency).

**POS hide filter:** When the business setting `pos_hide_without_checkout_currency_price`
is enabled (`1`) and this parameter is set, product list, search, and show endpoints
exclude products that have no manual checkout-currency price (or `open_amount`).
Search uses the database repository instead of Meilisearch while this filter is active.
